what: The table every meeting-URL redactor is held to: the TypeScript one in @vexa/join (src/shared/url-redaction.ts) and the Python one vendored into meeting-api, agent and flows (meeting_url_redaction.py). Each suite reads its own byte-identical copy (gate:fact-parity, fact meeting-url-redaction-vectors).

redact_url.why: Zoom passcode, long spelling, on a hosted front door
Zoom host token and registration token
Zoom web client keeps the meeting id in the path
Teams deep link: the thread id is the path, context carries directory ids and no secret
Jitsi JWT in the query, display name in the fragment
any key, token or secret parameter, case-insensitive
Google Meet carries no secret and is left alone
an empty value has nothing to hide
a parameter with no equals sign stays
an HTML-escaped ampersand (a calendar description) still separates parameters

redact_urls_in.why: a Playwright navigation error quotes the URL
redact_urls_in.in:
page.goto: Timeout 60000ms exceeded.
Call log:
  - navigating to "https://app.zoom.us/wc/81234567890/join?pwd=TESTPASSCODE", waiting until "domcontentloaded"
redact_urls_in.out:
page.goto: Timeout 60000ms exceeded.
Call log:
  - navigating to "https://app.zoom.us/wc/81234567890/join?pwd=***", waiting until "domcontentloaded"

redact_urls_in.in: Sent the bot to https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/374?p=TESTTEAMSPASSCODE. Admit it.
redact_urls_in.out: Sent the bot to https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/374?p=***. Admit it.

redact_urls_in.why: a parenthesised URL keeps its closing parenthesis
text with no URL is unchanged
redact_urls_in.in: Host did not start the meeting
redact_urls_in.out: Host did not start the meeting

strip_host_tokens.why: the Zoom host token is removed, the attendee passcode stays
a start URL with only the host token loses its query

strip_host_tokens_in.why: an ICS description with a start link
an error string that quoted the link
